about: What two readers made of every placement the answer key (the Berean tables; Clear Bible for the New Testament) and EVIDENTIA disagreed on in the passages ind, val, val2 and held, of 200 placements the key counts right, of the key-doubt rows and of the places where BHSA cuts a written word otherwise than the key; read on 2026-09-30. Each entry names the word of the BSB, the words the key names for it (key) and the other reading (read, or supplied: the original writes nothing for it), each as chapter:verse:position and the word as the text prints it, and the verdict: corrected (the other reading is right and the key's is not), defensible (both are), confirmed (the key's is right and the other is not), neither, unsettled. readers: the side each reader took (key, read, both, neither, unsure); fable and opus are two models that read blind, shown neither each other's answer nor which reading was EVIDENTIA's. lead: where they differed or both said neither, the lead's reading and why. Evaluation data only: the scorer reads it and nothing else does; it is never a link and never a training label.
